snippet.title: Sneak In - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Sneak In is a marble shoot game with the theme of Amazonian Jungle. It is easy to play, but truly addictive. Your goal is to clear all the marbles before they reach the end of the path, and meanwhile, achieve Marbles and Combos as many as possible to get the highest score.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061550/Sneak_In_a_sphere_matcher_game/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
